description:
Godzilla Minus One returns in this intense new cinematic teaser, featuring the rise of Titan X and a looming clash with King Kong. Set in a post-war Japan still recovering from devastation, a new threat emerges from the depths, pushing humanity to the brink once again.

The MonsterVerse expands as ancient titans awaken, bringing unprecedented destruction and forcing mankind into a desperate fight for survival. With stunning visual effects and large-scale action, this teaser sets up one of the most anticipated kaiju showdowns yet.

Starring: Ryunosuke Kamiki, Minami Hamabe
Directed by: Takashi Yamazaki
Production: Toho Co., Ltd.
Franchise: MonsterVerse

Enjoy advanced 4K Upscaling and HDR-10 mastering across future trailers. Stay tuned for more.
